question: Under the Income-tax Act, 2025, how is the term "tax year" defined?
answer: The twelve-month period of the financial year commencing on 1st April (section 3(1)); it replaces the 1961 Act's "previous year"/"assessment year" pair.
evidence: “tax year” means the twelve months period of the financial year commencing on the 1st April

question: Under the Income-tax Act, 2025, when a business or profession is newly set up during a financial year, when does its first tax year begin and end?
answer: It begins on the date of setting up of the business or profession and ends with that financial year (section 3(2)).
evidence: In the case of a business or profession newly set up, or a source of income newly coming into existence in any financial year, the tax year shall be the period beginning with
(a) the date of setting up of such business or profession
and ending with the said financial year

question: Under the Income-tax Act, 2025, if a new source of income first comes into existence in the middle of a financial year, from what date does the tax year for that source begin?
answer: From the date on which the source of income newly comes into existence, ending with that financial year (section 3(2)(b)).
evidence: (b) the date on which such source of income newly comes into existence, and ending with the said financial year

question: How does section 2 of the Income-tax Act, 2025 define the "average rate of income-tax"?
answer: The rate arrived at by dividing the income-tax calculated on the total income by that total income (section 2(16)).
evidence: “average rate of income-tax” means the rate arrived at by dividing the amount of income-tax calculated on the total income, by such total income

question: Under the definition of "block of assets" in the Income-tax Act, 2025, which intangible asset is expressly excluded?
answer: Goodwill of a business or profession (section 2(17)(b)).
evidence: “block of assets” means a group of assets falling within a class of assets comprising of
not being goodwill of a business or profession, in respect of which the same percentage of depreciation is prescribed

question: Does the definition of "books or books of account" in the Income-tax Act, 2025 cover accounts kept on cloud-based storage?
answer: Yes; it covers books kept in electronic or digital form or on cloud based storage (section 2(19)(b)).
evidence: “books or books of account” includes ledgers, day-books, cash books, account-books and other books
(b) in electronic or any digital form, or on cloud based storage

answer: 10% (section 202(1) Table, Sl. No. 3).

question: Under section 423 of the Income-tax Act, 2025, at what rate is simple interest charged for delay in furnishing the return of income?
